name: Tone & Policy Checker
description:
Paste text and get a heads-up if it might cross a line — offensive language or personal information (PII) — before you post or send it, checked privately on your device.

**How it works:** You paste text, a local AI model checks it against the policy, and you get a warning if something looks risky.

**Setup:**
- Install and enable the awflow browser extension.
- Pick an on-device AI model the first time you run it.

**Good for:** teams and creators who want a quick safety check before publishing.
setup: Install / enable the awflow browser extension.
